description: This file is a Smarty plugin that defines an output filter for trimming whitespace from template source code while preserving certain blocks like <script>, <pre>, and <textarea>. It provides a function to process the source, removing unnecessary whitespace and reinserting preserved blocks.

methods.name: smarty_outputfilter_trimwhitespace
methods.description: Processes Smarty template source to trim whitespace, preserving script, pre, and textarea blocks.

methods.name: smarty_outputfilter_trimwhitespace_replace
methods.description: Replaces placeholder markers with the original preserved blocks during trimming process.
